task_completion.description: Run the baseline simulation and generate the initial tripinfo XML file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal commands or GUI interaction showing SUMO running the bologna_acosta scenario, followed by the existence of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/baseline_tripinfos.xml in a file explorer or terminal 'ls' command.

task_completion.description: Modify at least 8 residential edges to a speed limit of 30 km/h (8.33 m/s).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of Netedit or XML editing showing speed attributes being changed to 8.33 for multiple edge IDs within the Acosta corridor.

task_completion.description: Implement additional traffic calming such as 20 km/h speed bumps on at least 2 edges or turn restrictions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Netedit or XML code showing at least two edges with speed limits reduced to 5.56 m/s (20 km/h) or specific connection/prohibition changes.

task_completion.description: Run the simulation with the modified network and generate the calming tripinfo XML file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SUMO GUI or command line execution showing the modified network being simulated, resulting in the creation of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/calming_tripinfos.xml.

task_completion.description: Create a CSV report comparing baseline and calming metrics with specific required columns.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A view of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/traffic_calming_report.csv containing columns: metric, baseline_value, calming_value, and change_pct.

task_completion.description: Produce a professional engineering summary text file documenting the design and impacts.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command showing the content of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/traffic_calming_summary.txt describing the zone design.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually used SUMO tools (Netedit/SUMO GUI/sumo-tools) rather than just creating text files manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the SUMO-GUI or Netedit interface active during the network modification or simulation phases.

integrity.description: Ensure the values in the CSV report match the data seen in the XML output files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Cross-referencing values shown in the terminal/editor for the XML tripinfos with the values typed into the CSV report.

integrity.description: Check that the agent used the specific file paths mandated by the city (City of Bologna requirements).
integrity.visual_evidence: File paths in the terminal or save dialogs matching /home/ga/SUMO_Output/ exactly.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target speed limit for the 8 residential edges is 8.33 m/s (equivalent to 30 km/h). Speed bumps should be set to 5.56 m/s (20 km/h). The required metrics for the CSV report are: zone_avg_speed, corridor_avg_travel_time, total_throughput, zone_85th_percentile_speed, and corridor_avg_speed. The scenario is located at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/.
